first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: crowd of spectators along the route
entities.identification: A collection of background people distributed along the track, including the crowd behind the barrier on the left and the people on the platform in front of the building entrance on the right; people in different sections of the route are not tracked as the same individuals, and foreground Person B is excluded.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The foreground person wearing black long sleeves and white gloves and holding the bicycle handlebars; only the hands and parts of the sleeved arms are visible.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The bicycle controlled by Person B, with a black flat handlebar, black front wheel, silver controls, and a red front component visible.

entities.name: track surface
entities.identification: The narrow gray hard-surfaced downhill road between the barrier on the left and the stone wall on the right.

entities.name: metal barriers along the route
entities.identification: The continuous tubular-frame mesh barriers on the left and the metal railing with vertical bars above the stone wall on the right in the later section.

entities.name: wall beside the track
entities.identification: The irregular stone masonry wall on the right, with red-and-white markings on the earlier section and a stone foundation wall beneath a building in the later section.

entities.name: residential buildings along the route
entities.identification: The group of buildings in the distance and on the right, including light-colored, white, and reddish-brown facades, roofs, windows, and balconies.

entities.name: blue sky
entities.identification: The blue sky area above the buildings and vegetation.

entities.name: vegetation along the route
entities.identification: The green tree crowns and foliage behind the spectators and along the upper edge of the wall.

entities.name: track promotional banner
entities.identification: The light-colored rectangular banner on the left-side barrier in the later section, with dark and red printed markings on its surface.

entities.name: utility poles along the route
entities.identification: The slender poles visible along the road, some connected to overhead lines.

entities.name: cables along the route
entities.identification: The thin overhead lines in the sky and the dark cables extending along the road edge at the base of the wall on the right in the earlier section.

entities.name: strip of bare soil beside the road
entities.identification: The narrow strip of soil with scattered debris between the road edge and the base of the wall on the right.

entities.name: spectator-held mobile phone
entities.identification: A collection of small rectangular devices in the hands of some spectators; individual devices are not tracked.
